glosses: À plusieurs voies, dans le contexte de routes.

examples.text: Auf der mehrspurigen Autobahn kam man gut vorwärts.

glosses: Having more than one lane of traffic traveling in at least one direction.

examples.text: The Government since 1956 has laced the U.S. with 33,000 miles of multilane highways.
What fascinated me the most were the futuristic superhighways, multilane ribbons of traffic filled with cars, buses and trucks.
